review.inclusion_rule: All 38 rows of review Table 1 = refs [12-14,18,21-54]. Refs 1-11,15-17,19-20,55-65 are not selected studies.
review.table1_vs_38: Table 1 has 38 rows matching the 38 selected. No discrepancy.

definitions.fulltext: true if methods+results on calibration were read from OA HTML/PDF (not abstract-only).
definitions.vpr: Variable Provenance Record = {output file, column, segment I, layer K, units, derivation chain, time support, pairing tolerance} as in PAPER_PLAN.
definitions.vpr_variable: yes=names W2 output file or column; partial=names constituents compared but not file/column/derivation; no=not stated; unknown=FT unavailable.
definitions.vpr_location: yes=segment I and/or layer K or named station mapped onto the grid for the obs-sim pairs; partial=reach/dam/epilimnion without I/K; no=only grid dimensions; unknown=FT unavailable.
definitions.vpr_reconstruct: From the paper alone (not SI). yes=I (or mapped station) + layer/depth + constituent identity + comparison period, enough that a second analyst would extract the same series. partial=some of these. no=cannot. unknown=FT missing and abstract silent. Output filename is never present in this set; yes does not require the filename.
definitions.control_rule: described=paper states withdrawal elevation / selective withdrawal / flow-control / diversion operation used in the run. not_mentioned=operations are in scope (multi-purpose dam, TGR, etc.) but state not declared. NA=not an operations/controller/TDG paper. TDG targets: none of the 38.
definitions.only_r2_not_nse: r2==true AND nse!=true. Includes papers whose only R2 is not W2 obs-sim skill; see table2_r2_is_w2_obs_sim_skill.
definitions.table2_r2_is_w2_obs_sim_skill: true only if the Table 2 number is goodness-of-fit between W2 output and field observations of that constituent.
definitions.metrics: Coded from the paper's own GOF for any model it reports (W2, SWAT, SWMM, complete-mix). Excerpt states which model.

skill_false.why_excerpt_head: Table 2 value is complete-mix TP vs Class A pan K in the dry season, not CE-QUAL-W2 goodness-of-fit.
Table 2 R2=0.70 is TPin vs inflow power-law, not W2 vs field TP.
CRITICAL Table 2 error: 0.6781 is inflow-T vs air-T correlation, tabulated as DO skill.
Parent calibration for [12] and [13]. Table 2 uses K-TP correlation.
Table 2 mislabels 0.92 as Flow/TN/TP; paper's 0.92 is W2 water-surface elevation. Rare case that names NSE as a W2 metric.
Table 2 highest R2 is a load-reduction response curve, not calibration skill.
Table 2 params list many WQ variables but the R2 values are P-load-reduction correlations per review §3.7.
